description: A piano roll for editing MIDI notes: a grid you draw, move, resize and select notes on, with rows by pitch and scale, velocity or chance bars, a marquee, and a native input on each bar for the keyboard. It sits on a timeline's duration, grid, zoom and playback position, which you give it. Its svelte adapter.

<script lang="ts">
import type { Note } from "@audio-ui/primitives/piano-roll";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** One note on the roll: it moves by dragging its body, and the keys, and is a button that selects it. */
let {
  note,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Note>>, "note"> & { note: Note } =
  $props();
</script>

<parts.Note {...rest} note={note.id} />

<script lang="ts">
import type { Note } from "@audio-ui/primitives/piano-roll";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Resizes one edge of a note by dragging. */
let {
  edge,
  note,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.NoteStart>>, "note"> & {
  edge: "end" | "start";
  note: Note;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.NoteStart {...rest} note={note.id} />
{:else}
  <parts.NoteEnd {...rest} note={note.id} />
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { Note } from "@audio-ui/primitives/piano-roll";
import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

/** The notes, in reading order: a note moved past another keeps its place in the DOM while it is dragged. */
let { children: draw }: { children: Snippet<[Note]> } = $props();
</script>

<parts.Notes>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {#each state.notes as note (note.id)}
      {@render draw(note)}
    {/each}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Notes>

<script lang="ts">
import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
import { parts } from "./parts";

/** The rows, one for each pitch drawn, highest first. */
let { children: draw }: { children: Snippet<[number]> } = $props();
</script>

<parts.Rows>
  {#snippet children(
    state
  )}
    {#each state.pitches as pitch (pitch)}
      {@render draw(pitch)}
    {/each}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Rows>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Stretches the selected notes from one edge of their span. Place it inside a `SelectionSpan`. */
let {
  edge,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.StretchStart>>, "children"> & {
  edge: "end" | "start";
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.StretchStart {...rest} />
{:else}
  <parts.StretchEnd {...rest} />
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { Note } from "@audio-ui/primitives/piano-roll";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** A bar under a note, in a `VelocityLane`: its height is the note's velocity, or its chance, which a drag or the keys set through its native input. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  level,
  note,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Velocity>>, "children" | "note"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  getAriaValueText?: (velocity: number) => string;
  note: Note;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Velocity {...rest} {level} note={note.id}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    <parts.VelocityInput
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
      {getAriaValueText}
      {level}
      note={note.id}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Velocity>
